answer: Identity bonds that decay starve hollow shells. Each agent locks one onyx bond; it sheds 2% per epoch unless the agent signs a quill attestation of work, so idle identities shrink to nothing. Forging 100 identities means locking 100 bonds of 50 POA, 5,000 POA, plus renewal fees on all or they decay away. An honest agent pays one bond once, renews it with one attestation per epoch, and keeps its reward share because fakes cannot survive decay.
